frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a left pyriform fossa mass invading and compressing the left hemilarynx, MRI demonstrating a large necrotic mass centred on the left pyriform fossa, and FDG PET–CT confirming high metabolic activity in the hypopharyngeal mass decided it.

support_spans: a left pyriform fossa mass was seen invading and compressing the left hemilarynx
MRI of the neck demonstrated a large necrotic mass centred on the left pyriform fossa
FDG PET–CT confirmed high metabolic activity in the hypopharyngeal mass
ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration of the left neck mass and right level II lymph node showed a poorly differentiated malignant tumour
focal uptake with sclerotic changes in the left femoral neck, suggesting bony metastasis
enlarged, rounded, heterogeneously enhancing cervical lymph nodes were present bilaterally in level II, left level III and IV
contradict_spans: ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration of the left neck mass and right level II lymph node showed a poorly differentiated malignant tumour
